faqs: Do you supply coffee to cafés, hotels and restaurants?
Yes. We supply roasted coffee beans, espresso blends and South Indian filter coffee blends to cafés, hotels, restaurants and QSR chains, with consistent batch-to-batch quality.
What is the minimum order quantity?
The minimum order is 100 kg. Volume discounts are available on orders of 500 kg and 1,000 kg and above.
How do I get a quote for a bulk order?
Fill the enquiry form with the product and quantity you need, call or WhatsApp +91 89772 30767, or email sales@malnadcoffeehouse.com.
Can you create a custom roast or private label?
Yes. We offer light, medium, medium-dark and dark roast profiles, custom blend ratios, and private label and white-label manufacturing.
